name: Slack MCP Server (korotovsky)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C2, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C1, C3; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for slack-mcp-server@1.3.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/korotovsky/slack-mcp-server.git`. The record carries no provenance attestation (`dist.attestations` is absent).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived. The latest release is 184 days old (more than 180); repository activity falls within the last 180 days. Latest release 1.3.0 is dated 2026-05-14; the newest commit on `master` is dated 2026-05-14; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-07-16.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README documents the message-posting tool as disabled by default. Quoted: “The `conversations_add_message` tool is disabled by default for safety.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Tokens are supplied through environment variables. The README documents two token types: Slack browser session tokens and OAuth tokens. Quoted: “`SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN` | Yes* | `nil` | Slack browser token (`xoxc-...`) |”; “`SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN` | Yes* | `nil` | User OAuth token (`xoxp-...`) — alternative to xoxc/xoxd |”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: mcp-go v0.44.0 in go.mod. Lower-bound version v0.44.0 of github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go was published on 2026-02-15, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
